description: This file defines a class 'GenericOAuthProviderConnector' that extends 'ExternalOAuthProviderConnector' to implement OAuth provider-specific logic for Microsoft. It includes methods to return the provider type and to map access tokens from the OAuth response.

classes.name: GenericOAuthProviderConnector
classes.description: A class that implements OAuth provider-specific behavior for Microsoft by extending ExternalOAuthProviderConnector.

methods.name: getProviderType
methods.description: Returns the string identifier for the OAuth provider type, which is 'Microsoft'.

methods.name: mapAccessToken
methods.description: Maps the OAuth access token object to an array with token details, either dynamically or using basic fields.

methods.name: getProviderType
methods.description: Returns the string 'Microsoft' as the provider type.

methods.name: mapAccessToken
methods.description: Transforms an AccessTokenInterface object into an associative array with access_token, expires_in, and refresh_token.
